name: Barbamon
main_effect:
When this card would be played, if your opponent has 10 or more cards in either their hand or trash, reduce the play cost by 5.
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Your opponent trashes cards in their hand so that they have 6 cards left. If this effect didn't trash, you may play 1 level 5 or lower [Fallen Angel] trait Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
[End of Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] If your opponent has 6 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 of them. Then, if they have 5 or fewer, delete 1 of their lowest level Digimon.
set_name: ST-22: Advanced Deck Set Amethyst Mandala
